defs.meaning: 爱因斯坦（著名物理学家）

examples.en: Einstein had the chutzpah to discard long-established theory.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦拥有抛弃早已既定的理论之胆识。

examples.en: Einstein was one of the greatest thinkers of the 20th century.
examples.zh: 爱因斯坦是20世纪最伟大的思想家之一。

examples.en: Einstein was a scientist who hated pomposity and disliked being called a genius.
examples.zh: 科学家爱因斯坦不喜欢摆架子，也不喜欢被称为天才。
